title: Mate in one
summary: Find the move that ends the game.

puzzles.hint: The rook can reach the 8th rank. Black's pawns block the king.
puzzles.success: Back-rank mate. The king has no flight square.

puzzles.prompt: White to move. Checkmate the king on h8.
puzzles.hint: Slide the queen along the 7th rank, next to the king. Your king protects her.
puzzles.success: Qg7 is mate. The queen is protected by the king.

puzzles.prompt: White to move. The bishop on c4 eyes f7.
puzzles.hint: The queen captures on f7, and the bishop protects her.
puzzles.success: Qxf7 is checkmate. This is the idea behind Scholar's Mate.

title: Forks
summary: Attack two pieces with one move.

puzzles.prompt: Fork the king and the queen.
puzzles.hint: The knight on d4 has a jump that hits g7 and e3.
puzzles.success: Nf5 checks the king and attacks the queen.

puzzles.prompt: Fork the king on e8 and the rook on a8.
puzzles.hint: Look for a knight jump to c7.
puzzles.success: Nc7 attacks the king and the rook.

puzzles.prompt: Push a pawn so it attacks both knights.
puzzles.hint: A pawn on d4 attacks c5 and e5.

title: Pins
summary: Line up an attacker, a piece, and the king.

puzzles.prompt: Pin the knight on c6 to the king.
puzzles.hint: The bishop wants the diagonal that runs through c6.
puzzles.success: Bb5 pins the knight. It cannot move without exposing the king.

puzzles.prompt: Pin the knight on e5 to the king on e8.
puzzles.success: The rook pins the knight. Moving it would expose the king.

title: Hanging pieces
summary: Take the piece that nobody defends.

puzzles.hint: The rook and the queen share the d-file.

puzzles.prompt: The knight on d5 is undefended. Capture it.
puzzles.hint: The bishop on a2 has a clear diagonal.
puzzles.success: Bxd5 picks up the knight for free.

title: Get out of check
summary: Move the king, capture the checker, or block.

puzzles.prompt: You are in check. Capture the unprotected queen.
puzzles.hint: The checking queen is next to your king and has no defender.

puzzles.prompt: Step the king off the e-file. Either safe square works.
puzzles.hint: d1 and f1 are not on the queen's line.
puzzles.success: The king left the file, so the check is over.

puzzles.prompt: Block the rook check by putting the queen on e2.
puzzles.hint: The check runs down the e-file. Stand on e2.
